verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a physical desktop CPU, so reading the product's source under an open license is not a fair axis for buyers comparing consumer desktop processors. Nothing in the evidence suggests AMD ships any open-source design or firmware for this chip; the docs cover only hardware specs and the Ryzen Master tuning utility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
